ROOT CAUSE: The link is a path-based `/api/files/raw?path=…` link to the DOCX in the worker’s worktree. `app/static/js/chat.js` builds raw file URLs; `app/routes/system.py:get_file_raw` returns 404 when that exact path no longer exists. Archiving through `app/manager.py:Manager.remove` removes the worker worktree with `remove_worktree` before marking the session archived (`app/db.py:archive_session`). The DOCX can remain in the main checkout, but the stored link still targets the removed worktree path.

This snapshot contains no stored chat message, archive row, DOCX, or logs, so I could not verify the specific URL or timestamps against raw instance records. The code confirms the failure mechanism; the claim that this message’s link used the worker path follows from the reported symptom.
